action.name: Design Phase
action.keywords: design plan blueprint calculate invent crafting limit

test.bonusstring: Design the item before crafting it; hits set the limit for the item's attributes or rating. Glitch gives a noticeable quirk, critical glitch a fatal flaw discovered only on use.

action.notes: Costs nothing and can be repeated until satisfied (start over instead of adding hits, unless you use Edge). Knowledge skill depends on the item being designed.

action.name: Study Design
action.keywords: study reverse engineer analyse design exploit flaw

test.dice: {LOG} + {Appropriate Knowledge Skill} v. the design's successes
test.bonusstring: Study someone else's design with the same roll it was made with. Beat its successes to learn it and gain +2 dice to use or break it; double them to discover an exploit that auto-succeeds at breaking or bypassing it.

action.notes: Also applies to hardware designs (+2 to hack it, or auto-bypass its security on a big success).

action.name: Craft General Gear
action.keywords: craft make build gear tools rope small items

test.bonusstring: Hits go toward the gear's attribute or rating, or if it has none, how many copies you make with one roll.

action.notes: Limited by design phase hits. 1 spare part of the TL per unit (per attribute if several); small items give 100 rolls per spare part. 1 hour per attribute/rating/roll, faster or slower by tech level difference (from 5 min at -3 to 12 hours at +3).

action.name: Craft Lock
action.keywords: lock make lock build lock electronic mechanical alarm

test.bonusstring: Build a mechanical or electronic lock; hits set its rating. Electronic locks can carry an alarm that triggers if an intruder does not pick it in one roll.

action.notes: Limited by design. Alarm requires hardware with Data Processing. Toolkit works; shop gives +2 dice, facility +4.

action.name: Craft Mechanical Lock Picks
action.keywords: lockpicks picks make lock picks

test.bonusstring: Make mechanical lock picks; more hits means more lock picks.

action.notes: 1 hour. 1 spare part per 100 rolls. Shop +2 dice, facility +4.

action.name: Pick Mechanical Lock
action.keywords: lockpicking pick lock open door mechanical lock

test.bonusstring: Pick a mechanical lock; threshold equals the lock's rating.

action.notes: Tech level difference (lock TL - pick TL): -3 = +8, -2 = +4, -1 = +2, +1 = -2, +2 = -4, +3 = -8; below -3 auto success, above 3 auto failure. +2 dice if you studied the lock's design. Electronic locks with an alarm trigger it if not picked in one roll.

action.name: Defeat Lock Alarm
action.keywords: alarm disable electronic lock bypass sleaze

test.bonusstring: Using hardware with a Sleaze attribute, disable an electronic lock's alarm on a success; on a failure the device's response (usually the alarm) triggers.

action.name: Pick Electronic Lock
action.keywords: lockpicking electronic picker maglock open door

test.bonusstring: With an electronic picker, open an electronic lock; threshold equals the lock's rating (uses Logic, not Agility).

action.notes: Same tech level modifiers as mechanical picking. Defeat the alarm first if present.

action.name: Craft Melee Weapon
action.keywords: melee weapon sword blade club forge make weapon

test.bonusstring: Roll once for each attribute (DV, AP, Accuracy); hits become that attribute's value.

action.notes: Reach chosen first, limited by TL; costs 1 + Reach spare parts. DV limited by TL*TL. Each roll takes Reach/TL hours. Shop tools needed; facility +2 dice. Limited by design.

action.name: Craft Ranged Weapon
action.keywords: gun firearm rifle pistol bow crossbow artillery make weapon

test.bonusstring: Roll for each attribute: DV, AP, Accuracy, modes (each hit adds SS/SA/BF/FA), ammo capacity (hits*6 clip, hits*50 belt) and range (hits*TL short; medium = short*10, long = medium*3, extreme = long*2).

action.notes: Parts by type: bow 1, handgun 1, SMG 2, crossbow 3, rifle 3, sniper 3, machine gun 4, assault cannon 5. Each roll takes (1 + weapon type)/TL hours. Artillery: short range max hits*TL*10, capacity = hits, scatter = short range/(Accuracy + hits). Facility +2 dice. Limited by design.

action.name: Overcharge Energy Weapon
action.keywords: overcharge energy weapon laser plasma explode overload

test.bonusstring: An overcharged energy weapon deals double DV and AP; after shooting, make this test. On failure the gun explodes, dealing its original DV and AP to you.

action.name: Craft Ammunition
action.keywords: ammo bullets rounds grenades rockets shells reload handload

test.bonusstring: Hits determine how many bullets per minute you produce; parts are paid per bullet (1/500 part plus property costs).

action.notes: The book does not name the skill for ammunition (Armorer assumed). Properties selectable up to design phase successes. Grenades 2/100 part base (free TL*TL DV), rockets cost x20, shells 1/5 part.

action.name: Craft Armor
action.keywords: armor armour vest helmet shield make armor

test.bonusstring: Hits set the armor rating; requires hits/2 (round down) spare parts.

action.notes: Each roll takes armor rating/2 hours. Limited by design; rating max is TL max hardware rating*2 (24 for SR). Shields made the same way.

action.name: Harden Armor
action.keywords: harden hardened armor armour upgrade

test.bonusstring: Harden body armor or a helmet; same roll as making the armor with threshold armor rating - TL*2, costing twice the spare parts.

action.name: Build Vehicle (Body and Armor)
action.keywords: build vehicle car ship starship chassis body armor hull construct mech

test.bonusstring: Roll for the Body attribute, then for the Armor attribute; hits become the attribute.

action.notes: Limit = design rating, 1 hour per rating. Spare parts = (Body + Armor)/2 * seats. HP = 6 + Body/2 for drones, 12 + Body/2 otherwise. Starships also roll for Mass and Hardpoints (skill not stated).

action.name: Build Vehicle (Handling, Speed, Acceleration)
action.keywords: build vehicle handling speed acceleration engine performance

test.bonusstring: Roll separately for Handling, Speed and Acceleration; hits become the attribute.

action.notes: Limit = design rating, 1 hour per roll. Speed and Acceleration limited by TL*TL.

action.name: Program Vehicle Pilot
action.keywords: pilot program autopilot vehicle drone mech software

test.bonusstring: Create the Pilot attribute of a vehicle or mech; cannot exceed the rating of its hardware device (usually the sensor array).

action.notes: Limited by design; takes attribute rating hours.

action.name: Build Sensor Array
action.keywords: sensor array vehicle sensors hardware mech

test.bonusstring: Make a sensor array as hardware and upgrade it by the normal hardware rules.

action.notes: Limited by design; 1 hour per rating.

action.name: Navigator Rating
action.keywords: navigator starship fitting navigation computer

test.bonusstring: Hits set the rating of the Navigator fitting, which adds to pilot skill checks.

action.name: Pierce Sensor Mask
action.keywords: sensor mask disguise ship hull matrix perception detect

test.dice: {Computer} + {INT} v. opposed by the masking ship
test.bonusstring: An opposed matrix perception test to see through a ship's Sensor Mask; useless once the ship is seen visually.

action.notes: Uses the core SR5 Matrix Perception pool (Computer + Intuition [Data Processing]).

action.name: Find Smuggler's Hold
action.keywords: search smuggler hold hidden compartment contraband inspect

test.bonusstring: Extended perception search to find a smuggler's hold: threshold 10 at one hour per roll, or threshold 7 at one week per roll.

action.notes: Alternative: [7, one week] search, practically a disassembly.

action.name: Planetary Defence Array
action.keywords: planetary defence defense array orbital bombardment nuke snuffer

test.bonusstring: Roll every time the array is used; hits decrease the hits of an orbital attack, deflect it or dissipate it.

action.name: Clear Weapon Jam (Jamming)
action.keywords: jam jamming starship weapon quality armoury

test.bonusstring: Each time a Jamming weapon fires, pass this armoury check or lose your next turn clearing the jam.

action.notes: The book says only "armoury skill check"; Logic assumed as the attribute.

action.name: Reset Twin Link
action.keywords: twin linked starship weapon reset armoury

test.bonusstring: Reset a Twin linked weapon's attacks once you have run out of linked attacks.

action.notes: The book says only "armoury skill check"; Logic assumed.

action.name: Cool Hot Weapon
action.keywords: hot weapon heat cooldown starship armoury

test.bonusstring: Armoury roll hits help regain the dice lost to the Hot weapon quality.

action.notes: Attribute not stated; Logic assumed. You also regain one die each turn you do not shoot.

action.name: Armature Design
action.keywords: armature robot shell android design AI VI

test.bonusstring: Design phase for an armature; hits limit its initial physical attributes.

action.name: Build Armature Attributes
action.keywords: armature robot body physical attributes build android

test.bonusstring: Roll once for each of the four physical attributes; each hit takes 1 hour.

action.notes: Needs 1/5 spare parts equal to the desired attribute rating. Mental attributes come from the VI/AI.

action.name: Armature Armor
action.keywords: armature armor armour plating robot

test.bonusstring: Create the armature's (stackable) armor rating; requires hits/2 spare parts.

action.notes: Limited by design; each roll takes armor rating/2 hours.

action.name: Armature Health Boxes
action.keywords: armature health boxes hit points condition monitor robot

test.bonusstring: Add health boxes to an armature (up to design successes); threshold and hours equal the box count.

action.notes: 2 spare parts per health box.

action.name: Armature Synthetic Skin
action.keywords: synthetic skin human appearance android disguise armature

test.bonusstring: Cover the armature in synthetic skin and organic features indistinguishable from human; threshold and hours equal its Body.

action.notes: Up to Body rating of chemical parts.

action.name: Mech Running
action.keywords: mech suit run sprint movement

test.bonusstring: When running, suits add 10 * successes meters and light/heavy mechs add 20 * successes meters to their movement for the round.

action.notes: Uses the core Running test; book only says "when rolling running".

action.name: Mech Ammunition Check
action.keywords: mech ammo ammunition out of ammo reload check

test.dice: {Max: {LOG} or {AGI}} + {Armorer} v. bullets fired + combat rounds spent firing
test.bonusstring: Each time you fire conventional mech guns, beat bullets fired + rounds spent firing to still have ammo; otherwise you are out.

action.notes: Logic or Agility. Ammunition Cells fitting allows one reroll of a failed check.

action.name: Build Mech (Body and Armor)
action.keywords: build mech suit chassis body armor

test.bonusstring: Roll for the mech's Body, then its Armor.

action.notes: Limit = design rating, 1 hour per rating. Spare parts = (Body + Armor + Power + Mass) * Speed * maintenance for size; caster mechs cost double. Pilot and sensor array as for vehicles.

action.name: Build Mech (Mass)
action.keywords: build mech mass hardpoints

test.bonusstring: Roll for the mech's Mass attribute.

action.notes: Limit = design rating, 1 hour per hit. Size limits apply (suit 10, light 20, heavy 40).

action.name: Build Mech (Speed)
action.keywords: build mech speed movement

test.bonusstring: Roll for the mech's Speed attribute.

action.notes: Limit = design rating, 1 hour per roll. Speed limited by TL*2.

action.name: Comm Interceptor Snoop
action.keywords: snoop intercept comm encryption military mech fitting

test.dice: {Electronic Warfare} + {LOG} + 4 v. Intuition + Sleaze or Sleaze * 2
test.bonusstring: Break military-grade comm encryption with the Comm Interceptors fitting; you must see the source or receiver. Civilian encryption breaks automatically.

action.name: Field Medical Unit
action.keywords: medical drones first aid heal mech fitting treat

test.bonusstring: Spend a round guiding medical drones to treat up to 20 individuals within 200 meters at once.

action.name: Inquisitor Probe
action.keywords: read mind telepathy probe tactical plan caster mech

test.bonusstring: Caster pilot (Telepath-1+) targets a visible person or mech; success gives an impression of their tactical plan and foremost thoughts. A successful save makes the target immune for 24 hours.

action.name: Slow Weapon Cooldown
action.keywords: slow weapon cooldown mech overheat

test.bonusstring: A Slow mech weapon (double additional damage) requires this test; on a failure the weapon must cool down for one round.

action.notes: Armorer + Logic or Spellcasting + Logic.

action.name: Astral Weapon Attack
action.keywords: astral weapon mech attack magic tradition

test.dice: {Max: {LOG} or {CHA} or {INT}} + {Weapon: Skill} v. {Action: Ranged Defense}
test.bonusstring: Astral weapons ignore conventional armor; attack with your tradition attribute + combat skill instead of Agility + combat skill.

action.notes: Formula takes the highest of Logic/Charisma/Intuition; substitute your tradition's attribute. Defense test not specified by the book.

action.name: Craft Drug
action.keywords: drug chemistry cook narcotic stim make drugs dose

test.bonusstring: Threshold and hours equal the drug's addiction threshold (number of different changes). Multiple doses with one roll by paying parts for each.

action.notes: Each modification costs 1/100 part per point. Addiction rating = positive - negative points (0-12).

action.name: Addiction Test (Physical)
action.keywords: addiction resist drug physical dependency

test.bonusstring: Resist a physical addiction; on failure addiction rises one level or you gain the addiction quality.

action.notes: Required each time you use during (12 - Addiction Rating) weeks in a row; each week clean reduces threshold by 1. Substances with both qualities need both tests. BTLs: rating 6, threshold 2.

action.name: Addiction Test (Mental)
action.keywords: addiction resist drug mental psychological BTL dependency

test.bonusstring: Resist a mental addiction; on failure addiction rises one level or you gain the addiction quality.

action.notes: BTLs have addiction rating 6 and threshold 2.

action.name: BTL Design
action.keywords: BTL better than life chip simsense design

test.bonusstring: Design phase for a BTL card; hits set its maximum rating (max 6) and how many properties can be taken.

action.notes: 1/100 part per rating. Properties up to twice the BTL rating.

action.name: Install BTL Property
action.keywords: BTL property sensation mood program chip

test.bonusstring: Successes determine how many times you can take that property.

action.name: BTL Recording Quality
action.keywords: BTL recording artisan simsense quality

test.bonusstring: If you record the BTL event yourself, an artisan check determines the quality of the recording.

action.notes: Book says "artisan check"; core Artisan pool (Intuition) assumed.

action.name: Build Machine
action.keywords: machine machinery factory production line drive miner build

test.bonusstring: Build a machine (rating 1 first, then upgrade); threshold and hours equal the rating.

action.notes: Upgrade cost in spare parts equals the target rating. Rating max by TL and size (portable/station/line/room). Drives are built the same way (room size, max 6).

action.name: Rebalance Equipment
action.keywords: modify rebalance tweak adjust equipment attributes

test.bonusstring: Spend 1 spare part; hits are points you can move from one attribute to another (no points added).

action.notes: Book says "appropriate skill check"; Logic assumed as with other crafting rolls.

action.name: Upgrade Equipment
action.keywords: upgrade improve boost equipment power attributes

test.bonusstring: Pay 10% of the item's spare part cost; hits are points to distribute among attributes. Only once per item.

action.notes: Book says "appropriate skill check"; Logic assumed.

action.name: Repair
action.keywords: repair fix damage mend vehicle gear

test.bonusstring: Hits equal damage boxes or rating fixed per hour; each box costs one spare part.

action.name: Construction
action.keywords: construction build building wall barrier structure

test.bonusstring: Each hit builds a 1 by 1 meter area with the chosen Body and Armor.

action.notes: Limited by design. Spare parts per roll = (Body + Armor) * 5. Barrier HP = 8 + Body/2.

action.name: Juryrigging
action.keywords: juryrig jury rig improvise hack together bypass temporary fix

test.dice: {LOG} + {Appropriate Skill} + 2 v. gear rating (or count, attribute, skill, property cost) - 1
test.bonusstring: Juryrigger quality: temporarily revive a destroyed device ((net hits + 1)D6 minutes), raise a device rating by 1 ((net hits + 1)D6 turns), boost a vehicle attribute by +1, improvise a one-shot device, or bypass a security measure.

action.notes: The +2 is the Juryrigger quality bonus to Mechanical Tests. May need one spare part of the device's type.

action.name: Craft Cyberware
action.keywords: cyberware chrome implant install augmentation

test.bonusstring: Build custom cyberware; threshold and hours equal the rating.

action.notes: Spare parts = rating + number of attributes/rolls/skills changed. Installing existing ware costs 1 spare part, threshold and time by its rating/size. Essence 1/0.5/0.2/0.05 * rating by type.

action.name: Craft Bioware
action.keywords: bioware biotech implant organic augmentation

test.bonusstring: Build custom bioware; threshold equals rating, takes rating*5 hours.

action.notes: Same spare parts as cyber but chemical; essence cost 5 times less than similar cyber.

action.name: Build Hardware Frame
action.keywords: hardware frame commlink cyberdeck server chip device build

test.bonusstring: Build the device frame; threshold and hours equal the rating. At rating 1 the roll determines how many chips you make.

action.notes: Parts per rating step: small 1/100, commlink 1/5, cyberdeck 1, server 3 (pay for every rating). Data Processing and Sleaze need 1 extra part each.

action.name: Hardware Attack and Firewall
action.keywords: hardware attack firewall matrix attributes

test.bonusstring: Hits set the Attack or Firewall attribute; cannot exceed the frame rating.

action.notes: Takes frame rating in hours. Matrix HP = 8 + Firewall/2.

action.name: Hardware Data Processing and Sleaze
action.keywords: hardware data processing sleaze matrix attributes

test.bonusstring: Hits set the Data Processing or Sleaze attribute; cannot exceed the frame rating.

action.notes: Takes frame rating in hours. Upgrades/modifications can go up to rating + 3.

action.name: Write Program
action.keywords: program code software write physical program

test.bonusstring: Beat the summed thresholds of the chosen scaling, attribute and action properties; 1 hour per threshold point.

action.notes: Design acts as the threshold limit. Physical programs are made the same way with their own property table (minimum threshold 1).

action.name: Program Autosoft
action.keywords: autosoft drone vehicle skill program

test.bonusstring: Hits set the autosoft's rating (max TL*2); you or a helper must have the skill.

action.notes: Limit = design rating, 1 hour.

action.name: Program Autosoft Technique
action.keywords: autosoft technique martial arts drone program

test.bonusstring: Program techniques (up to autosoft rating) that you or the helper know; extended test, 1 hour per karma.

action.name: Reprogram Skillsoft
action.keywords: skillsoft reprogram chip knowsoft activesoft

test.bonusstring: On success, replace one skill on an existing skillsoft chip with another; threshold and hours equal its rating.

action.notes: You or a friend must have the new skill.

action.name: Craft Matrix Construct
action.keywords: matrix construct build automaton host repair bricked construct

test.dice: {Software} + {LOG} v. total attribute points in the part
test.bonusstring: Extended test (1 hour) per construct part; any shortfall in the threshold is lost permanently as attribute points.

action.notes: Repairing a bricked construct means constructing it again. Automatons and hosts are built the same way.

action.name: Override Host Physics
action.keywords: host rules gravity physics override attack

test.bonusstring: A device or item (e.g. anti-grav grenade) battles the host over whose rules of physics apply at that location.

action.name: Bypass Host Lock
action.keywords: host door lock digital pick lock sleaze

test.bonusstring: Defeat a host lock checked by Data Processing using a sleazy device.

action.name: Find Hidden Host Object
action.keywords: host hidden path encryption sleaze lock analyse

test.bonusstring: Uncover objects, paths, encryption or Sleaze-based locks hidden by the host.

action.name: Bypass Physics (Complex Form)
action.keywords: complex form bypass physics technomancer resonance

test.dice: {Spell: Force} * 2 v. Data Processing * 2 or Attack * 2
test.bonusstring: When the environment tries to enforce the physical property the target ignores, roll the form's Level * 2.

action.notes: Force here stands for the complex form's Level.

action.name: Trails (Complex Form)
action.keywords: trails data trail history complex form technomancer

test.bonusstring: Read the target's data trails; you read history in days equal to the net hits.

action.notes: Limited by the form's Level. Book wording ("from the target") is ambiguous about whose Sleaze.

action.name: Spellcrafting
action.keywords: spellcrafting create spell design custom spell arcana

test.bonusstring: Hits determine how many different properties you can pick for your spell. Glitch adds side effects; critical glitch may warrant a magic advancement table roll.

action.notes: Use your tradition's main attribute (formula takes the highest of Logic/Charisma/Intuition). Drain starts at F for TL3 spells.

action.name: Resist Mental Manipulation
action.keywords: resist manipulation mental mind control spell

test.bonusstring: Resist a mental manipulation spell; each turn afterwards you may resist again with a complex action to reduce the net hits.

action.notes: Ongoing resistance is Logic + Willpower - Force.

action.name: Resist Physical Manipulation
action.keywords: resist manipulation physical spell

test.bonusstring: Resist a physical manipulation spell (objects use object resistance).

action.name: Resist Change Temperature
action.keywords: freeze burn temperature spell resist

test.bonusstring: Living creatures resist the Change temperature effect with Body + Reaction.

action.name: Resist Illusion (Mana)
action.keywords: resist illusion mana magic spell disbelieve

test.bonusstring: Resist a magic-type illusion spell.

action.name: Resist Illusion (Physical)
action.keywords: resist illusion physical spell disbelieve

test.bonusstring: Resist a physical-type illusion spell.

action.name: Fling
action.keywords: fling throw telekinesis spell object

test.bonusstring: Fling an object of F kilograms; your spellcasting test is the attack and your Magic determines DV.

action.name: Animate (Break Free)
action.keywords: animate object telekinesis break free

test.bonusstring: Win this opposed test to break an animated object free of someone holding it.

action.name: Shake Off Bad Luck
action.keywords: bad luck curse prophecy resist

test.bonusstring: Each time the Bad luck effect triggers, roll to shake it off; otherwise roll checks twice and take the worse result.

action.name: Resist Remove Friction
action.keywords: remove friction slip fall prone telekinesis

test.bonusstring: Fail and you fall prone, unable to stand or move. Those who save are immune.

action.name: Remove Friction (Vehicle Control)
action.keywords: remove friction skid crash out of control vehicle

test.bonusstring: A ground vehicle driver must pass or go out of control, driving forward for a round and crashing into obstacles.

action.notes: Book says "Pilot skill check"; core Reaction + Pilot [Handling] used.

action.name: Resist Force Puppetry
action.keywords: puppet control body telekinesis resist

test.bonusstring: On a failure you lose control of your physical actions.

action.name: Resist Memory Edit
action.keywords: memory edit telepathy resist

test.bonusstring: Resist memory editing for the rest of the encounter; on failure you won't notice the changes until given reason to recall.

action.name: Resist Suppress Thoughts
action.keywords: suppress thoughts telepathy resist

test.bonusstring: Resist and become immune for the day; on failure the thought stays unthinkable for the encounter.

action.name: Resist Telepathic Assault
action.keywords: telepathic assault stun telepathy resist halve

test.bonusstring: Success halves the Fd6 (or (F+3)d6) stun damage.

action.name: Adept Power Crafting
action.keywords: adept power create meditation custom power

test.bonusstring: Meditation roll; hits determine how many different properties you can pick for your power. Critical glitch may warrant an adept advancement table roll.

action.name: Unpredictable Power
action.keywords: unpredictable adept power boost

test.bonusstring: Roll Magic + level to increase the main effect bonuses of the power.

action.notes: Add the power's level to the pool.

action.name: Control Wild Power (Mental)
action.keywords: wild power control adept

test.bonusstring: Roll to stop a Wild power with mental effects from going off.

action.name: Control Wild Power (Social)
action.keywords: wild power control adept

test.bonusstring: Roll to stop a Wild power with social effects from going off.

action.notes: Book says "charisma for social"; read as Willpower + Charisma.

action.name: Control Wild Power (Physical)
action.keywords: wild power control adept

test.bonusstring: Roll to stop a Wild power with physical effects from going off.

action.notes: Book says "body for physical"; read as Willpower + Body.

action.name: Resist Exertion Drain
action.keywords: exertion drain physical adept power resist

test.bonusstring: Powers with Exertion deal physical drain resisted with Body + Willpower.

action.name: Combat Sense
action.keywords: combat sense danger ambush surprise perception adept

test.bonusstring: Perception test to be alerted of a dangerous situation.

action.name: Voice Mimicry
action.keywords: voice mimic imitate impersonate adept

test.dice: {Impersonation} + {CHA} v. sensor rating * 2 or listener's perception
test.bonusstring: Mimic someone's voice; add the power's level to the dice pool.

action.notes: Add power level.

action.name: Commanding Voice
action.keywords: command voice order compel adept

test.bonusstring: On success give a simple forceful command carried out on their turn, or they stand confused; they snap out of it after one turn.

action.notes: +1 to defence for every person affected if multiple targets. Natural voice only, targets must understand.

action.name: Voice of Terror
action.keywords: terror fear scare voice adept

test.bonusstring: Affects everyone within Magic meters who hears it. If net hits exceed a target's Willpower they flee in fear.

action.notes: Add power level to the pool.

action.name: Face the Terror
action.keywords: fear courage resist voice of terror

test.dice: {WIL} + {LOG} v. Voice of Terror net hits
test.bonusstring: A target driven off by Voice of Terror must pass to face the adept again.

action.name: Warcry
action.keywords: warcry shout intimidate adept

test.bonusstring: Everyone within Magic meters who hears it gets -2 dice on all actions for net hits combat turns.

action.notes: Add power level to the pool.

action.name: Wall Running
action.keywords: wall run climb parkour adept

test.bonusstring: Hits are meters you can run up a wall.

action.name: Empathic Healing
action.keywords: heal empathic transfer damage adept

test.bonusstring: Heal one box of someone's physical damage per hit, taking the same damage yourself unresisted.

action.name: Facial Sculpting
action.keywords: facial sculpting disguise change face adept

test.bonusstring: Each hit changes one facial feature completely.

action.name: Linguistics
action.keywords: language learn linguistics adept

test.bonusstring: After 12 - Magic hours (min 1) of exposure, gain 1 rating in the language. Threshold 1 common, 2 uncommon, 3 obscure.

action.name: Motion Sense
action.keywords: motion sense detect movement adept

test.bonusstring: Detect movement: threshold 3 smaller than a dog/cat, 2 dwarf size, 1 human size, 0 troll and larger.

action.name: Relief
action.keywords: relief heal stun adept

test.bonusstring: Every net hit heals one box of stun damage.

action.notes: Book does not specify the target's opposing roll.

action.name: Rapid Draw
action.keywords: quick draw rapid draw holster pistol blade adept

test.bonusstring: Free action quick draw test with -1 threshold for a properly holstered blade, pistol or throwing weapon.

action.notes: Core quick draw (threshold 3) reduced by 1.

action.name: Rapid Sling
action.keywords: quick draw rapid sling rifle low ready adept

test.bonusstring: As Rapid Draw, for larger weapons on a sling or at low ready.

action.notes: Core quick draw (threshold 3) reduced by 1.

action.name: Three Dimensional Memory
action.keywords: memory recall recording eidetic adept

test.bonusstring: Recall a recording; threshold by time passed: 1 within 24 hours, 2 week, 3 month, 4 year, 5 over a year.

action.name: Adept Accident
action.keywords: accident glitch jinx adept

test.bonusstring: Any net hits make the target suffer a glitch; 4+ net hits is a critical glitch.

action.name: Enthralling Performance
action.keywords: performance enthrall distract audience adept

test.bonusstring: Hits act as a threshold modifier on the audience's perception tests while you perform.

action.notes: Book says "appropriate skill + Magic"; Performance assumed.

action.name: Alchemical Preparation
action.keywords: alchemy preparation potion enchant bullets trigger

test.bonusstring: Make an alchemical preparation in a container; threshold is Force, 1 hour per Force. Add a trigger observer.

action.notes: Force limit by container rating or whole spare parts (default 1), raised only by reagents. Enchanted bullets limited to Force 1 each.

action.name: Precognitive Chamber
action.keywords: precognition chamber starship bonus department

test.bonusstring: A precog level 2 magician adds bonus dice to a department equal to their spellcasting check.

action.name: Research Test
action.keywords: research advancement breakthrough higher TL study meditate

test.bonusstring: Logic + engineering or spellcasting skill + an associated knowledge skill (8 hours); successes reduce the score of negative advancement effects, eliminating them at 0.

action.notes: Glitch +1 difficulty, critical glitch +2. +6 per breakthrough already gained on the same research.

action.name: Experiment Check
action.keywords: experiment advancement breakthrough glitch higher TL

test.bonusstring: Extended test (4 hours per roll) aiming for a glitch or critical glitch to roll on the advancement table; a critical glitch can yield a breakthrough.

action.notes: Book says "appropriate attribute + skill" (Logic assumed). Difficulty +1 per TL above yours. Stopping loses research hits. +4 on the advancement table per previous breakthrough.

action.name: Malfunctioning Item Check
action.keywords: malfunction advancement item use fix
